## Summary

- What changed?
- Why?

## Validation

- Commands and results (including any skipped check and its reason):
- [ ] Validation matches the change type in `AGENTS.md`: docs/skills,
      blog content, or UI/config/runtime
- [ ] Changed files pass Prettier; changed skills have valid frontmatter and links
- [ ] Astro check and production build passed where required (Docker by default)
- [ ] Production preview checked where required, including both languages for
      shared UI and real search queries for search changes

## Process Update

- [ ] `docs/process.md` records any requirement, site behavior, or collaboration
      workflow change, or this is a routine content/formatting edit with no such change

## Risks

- Any regression risk, migration impact, or follow-up work
